q: Does making sodium bicarbonate lock up CO2?
title: Sodium bicarbonate and CO2 uptake
short: Bicarbonate is made by bubbling CO2 through soda ash solution, so CO2 is bound into the product. It is not a removal: the CO2 is released again when bicarbonate is heated or meets acid, in baking, fire extinguishers or flue gas cleaning. Report CO2 released, not a credit.

ul: Fuel and electricity for the plant in Scope 1 and 2.
CO2 bought or taken from your own lime kiln, as a separate line.
No negative figure for CO2 held in the product.

p: The GHG Protocol counts emissions released. CO2 held for months before release is not stored in any lasting way.
